verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's docs show users creating tasks in the app and handing them to session agents, with selectable workflows (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented, Freeform), registered sub-agents and a model selector. Users can also ask the session agent to open draft PRs, and tasks can be created from GitHub, Linear or Jira issues. The agent is not truly native, though: it runs on Claude Code or Codex, which you install and authenticate separately, and all evidence is vendor documentation. Missing for 10: a first-party built-in assistant that needs no separate harness, and independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation.
